ayahs.arabicText: یٰسٓۚ
ayahs.translation: Ya'. Sin.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الْقُرْاٰنِ الْحَكِیْمِۙ
ayahs.translation: By the Wise Qur'an,

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: you are truly among the Messengers,

ayahs.arabicText: عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِیْمٍؕ
ayahs.translation: on a Straight Way,

ayahs.arabicText: تَنْزِیْلَ الْعَزِیْزِ الرَّحِیْمِۙ
ayahs.translation: (and this Qur'an) is a revelation from the Most Mighty, the Most Compassionate

ayahs.arabicText: لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّاۤ اُنْذِرَ اٰبَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غٰفِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: so that you may warn a people whose ancestors were not warned before wherefore they are heedless.

ayahs.arabicText: لَقَدْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلٰۤى اَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Surely most of them merit the decree of chastisement; so they do not believe.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِیْۤ اَعْنَاقِهِمْ اَغْلٰلًا فَهِیَ اِلَى الْاَذْقَانِ فَهُمْ مُّقْمَحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We have put fetters around their necks which reach up to their chins so that they are standing with their heads upright,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَعَلْنَا مِنْۢ بَیْنِ اَیْدِیْهِمْ سَدًّا وَّ مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَاَغْشَیْنٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا یُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: and We have put a barrier before them and a barrier behind them, and have covered them up, so they are unable to see.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ سَوَآءٌ عَلَیْهِمْ ءَاَنْذَرْتَهُمْ اَمْ لَمْ تُنْذِرْهُمْ لَا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them for they shall not believe.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّمَا تُنْذِرُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الذِّكْرَ وَ خَشِیَ الرَّحْمٰنَ بِالْغَیْبِ١ۚ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَّ اَجْرٍ كَرِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: You can warn only him who follows the Admonition and fears the Merciful Lord without seeing Him. Give such a one good tidings of forgiveness and a generous reward.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْیِ الْمَوْتٰى وَ نَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوْا وَ اٰثَارَهُمْ١ۣؕ وَ كُلَّ شَیْءٍ اَحْصَیْنٰهُ فِیْۤ اِمَامٍ مُّبِیْنٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: We shall surely raise the dead to life and We record what they did and the traces of their deeds that they have left behind. We have encompassed that in a Clear Book.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اضْرِبْ لَهُمْ مَّثَلًا اَصْحٰبَ الْقَرْیَةِ١ۘ اِذْ جَآءَهَا الْمُرْسَلُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Recite to them, as a case in point, the story of the people of the town when the Messengers came to them.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ اَرْسَلْنَاۤ اِلَیْهِمُ اثْنَیْنِ فَكَذَّبُوْهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوْۤا اِنَّاۤ اِلَیْكُمْ مُّرْسَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We sent to them two Messengers and they rejected both of them as liars. Then We strengthened them with a third (Messenger).

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا مَاۤ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا١ۙ وَ مَاۤ اَنْزَلَ الرَّحْمٰنُ مِنْ شَیْءٍ١ۙ اِنْ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا تَكْذِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said: “We have been sent to you as Messengers.” The people of the town said: “You are only human beings like ourselves, and the Merciful Lord has revealed nothing. You are simply lying.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا رَبُّنَا یَعْلَمُ اِنَّاۤ اِلَیْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The Messengers said: “Our Lord knows that we have indeed been sent to you

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا عَلَیْنَاۤ اِلَّا الْبَلٰغُ الْمُبِیْنُ
ayahs.translation: and our duty is no more than to clearly convey the Message.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا اِنَّا تَطَیَّرْنَا بِكُمْ١ۚ لَئِنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهُوْا لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَ لَیَمَسَّنَّكُمْ مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: The people of the town said: “We believe you are an evil omen for us. If you do not desist, we will stone you or you will receive a grievous chastisement from us.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا طَآئِرُكُمْ مَّعَكُمْ١ؕ اَئِنْ ذُكِّرْتُمْ١ؕ بَلْ اَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The Messengers replied: “Your evil omen is with you. (Are you saying this) because you were asked to take heed? The truth is that you are a people who have exceeded all bounds.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَآءَ مِنْ اَقْصَا الْمَدِیْنَةِ رَجُلٌ یَّسْعٰى قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اتَّبِعُوا الْمُرْسَلِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: In the meantime a man came running from the far end of the town, saying: “My people, follow the Messengers;

ayahs.arabicText: اتَّبِعُوْا مَنْ لَّا یَسْئَلُكُمْ اَجْرًا وَّ هُمْ مُّهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: follow those who do not ask any recompense from you and are rightly-guided.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا لِیَ لَاۤ اَعْبُدُ الَّذِیْ فَطَرَنِیْ وَ اِلَیْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Why should I not serve the One Who created me and to Whom all of you shall be sent back?

ayahs.arabicText: ءَاَتَّخِذُ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖۤ اٰلِهَةً اِنْ یُّرِدْنِ الرَّحْمٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّیْ شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَیْئًا وَّ لَا یُنْقِذُوْنِۚ
ayahs.translation: What! Shall I take any deities apart from Him whose intercession will not avail me the least were the Merciful One to bring any adversity upon me, nor will they be able to rescue me?

ayahs.arabicText: اِنِّیْۤ اِذًا لَّفِیْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: Surely in that case I should indeed be in evident error.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنِّیْۤ اٰمَنْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَاسْمَعُوْنِؕ
ayahs.translation: I believe in your Lord; so listen to me.”

ayahs.arabicText: قِیْلَ ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ١ؕ قَالَ یٰلَیْتَ قَوْمِیْ یَعْلَمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: (Eventually they killed him and he was told): “Enter Paradise.” The man exclaimed: “Would that my people knew

ayahs.arabicText: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِیْ رَبِّیْ وَ جَعَلَنِیْ مِنَ الْمُكْرَمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: for what reason Allah has forgiven me and placed me among the honoured ones.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلٰى قَوْمِهٖ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ مِنْ جُنْدٍ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَ مَا كُنَّا مُنْزِلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: After him, We did not send down any hosts from the heaven; We stood in no need to send down any host.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ كَانَتْ اِلَّا صَیْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاِذَا هُمْ خٰمِدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: There was but a single Blast and suddenly they became silent and still.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى الْعِبَادِ١ۣۚ مَا یَاْتِیْهِمْ مِّنْ رَّسُوْلٍ اِلَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ یَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Alas for My servants! Never does a Messenger come to them but they mock him.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَمْ یَرَوْا كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِّنَ الْقُرُوْنِ اَنَّهُمْ اِلَیْهِمْ لَا یَرْجِعُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Have they not seen how many nations before them did We destroy? Thereafter they never came back to them.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنْ كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِیْعٌ لَّدَیْنَا مُحْضَرُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: All of them shall (one day) be gathered before Us.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اٰیَةٌ لَّهُمُ الْاَرْضُ الْمَیْتَةُ١ۖۚ اَحْیَیْنٰهَا وَ اَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ یَاْكُلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Let the dead earth be a Sign for them. We gave it life and produced from it grain whereof they eat.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَعَلْنَا فِیْهَا جَنّٰتٍ مِّنْ نَّخِیْلٍ وَّ اَعْنَابٍ وَّ فَجَّرْنَا فِیْهَا مِنَ الْعُیُوْنِۙ
ayahs.translation: We made in it gardens of date-palms and vines, and We caused springs to gush forth

ayahs.arabicText: لِیَاْكُلُوْا مِنْ ثَمَرِهٖ١ۙ وَ مَا عَمِلَتْهُ اَیْدِیْهِمْ١ؕ اَفَلَا یَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: that they might eat of its fruits. It was not their hands that made them. Will they not, then, give thanks?

ayahs.arabicText: سُبْحٰنَ الَّذِیْ خَلَقَ الْاَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنْۢبِتُ الْاَرْضُ وَ مِنْ اَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ مِمَّا لَا یَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Holy is He Who created all things in pairs, whether it be of what the earth produces, and of themselves, and of what they do not know.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اٰیَةٌ لَّهُمُ الَّیْلُ١ۖۚ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ النَّهَارَ فَاِذَا هُمْ مُّظْلِمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And the night is another Sign for them. We strip the day from it and they become plunged in darkness.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الشَّمْسُ تَجْرِیْ لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا١ؕ ذٰلِكَ تَقْدِیْرُ الْعَزِیْزِ الْعَلِیْمِؕ
ayahs.translation: The sun is running its course to its appointed place. That is the ordaining of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتّٰى عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُوْنِ الْقَدِیْمِ
ayahs.translation: We have appointed stages for the moon till it returns in the shape of a dry old branch of palm-tree.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا الشَّمْسُ یَنْۢبَغِیْ لَهَاۤ اَنْ تُدْرِكَ الْقَمَرَ وَ لَا الَّیْلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِ١ؕ وَ كُلٌّ فِیْ فَلَكٍ یَّسْبَحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Neither does it lie in the sun's power to overtake the moon nor can the night outstrip the day. All glide along, each in its own orbit.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اٰیَةٌ لَّهُمْ اَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّیَّتَهُمْ فِی الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُوْنِۙ
ayahs.translation: Another Sign for them is that We carried all their offspring in the laden vessel

ayahs.arabicText: وَ خَلَقْنَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ مِّثْلِهٖ مَا یَرْكَبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: and then created for them other vessels like those on which they ride.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنْ نَّشَاْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِیْخَ لَهُمْ وَ لَا هُمْ یُنْقَذُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Should We so wish, We can drown them, and there will be none to heed their cries of distress, nor will they be rescued.

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَ مَتَاعًا اِلٰى حِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: It is only Our Mercy (that rescues them) and enables enjoyment of life for a while.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا قِیْلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقُوْا مَا بَیْنَ اَیْدِیْكُمْ وَ مَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: When it is said to such people: “Guard yourselves against what is ahead of you and what has preceded you that mercy be shown to you” (they pay scant heed to it).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا تَاْتِیْهِمْ مِّنْ اٰیَةٍ مِّنْ اٰیٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ اِلَّا كَانُوْا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Never does any Sign of their Lord come to them, but they turn away from it.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا قِیْلَ لَهُمْ اَنْفِقُوْا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُ١ۙ قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا لِلَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْۤا اَنُطْعِمُ مَنْ لَّوْ یَشَآءُ اللّٰهُ اَطْعَمَهٗۤ١ۖۗ اِنْ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا فِیْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: And when it is said to them: “Spend (in the Way of Allah) out of the sustenance that Allah has provided you,” the unbelievers say to the believers: “Shall we feed him whom, Allah would have fed, had He so wished?” Say: “You are in evident error.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They say: “When will this threat (of Resurrection) come to pass? Tell us if indeed you are truthful.”

ayahs.arabicText: مَا یَنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَّا صَیْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً تَاْخُذُهُمْ وَ هُمْ یَخِصِّمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The Truth is that they are waiting for nothing but a mighty Blast to seize them the while they are disputing (in their worldly affairs),

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَا یَسْتَطِیْعُوْنَ تَوْصِیَةً وَّ لَاۤ اِلٰۤى اَهْلِهِمْ یَرْجِعُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: and they will not even be able to make a testament, nor to return to their households.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نُفِخَ فِی الصُّوْرِ فَاِذَا هُمْ مِّنَ الْاَجْدَاثِ اِلٰى رَبِّهِمْ یَنْسِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then the Trumpet shall be blown and lo! they will come out of their graves and be on the move towards their Lord,

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا یٰوَیْلَنَا مَنْۢ بَعَثَنَا مِنْ مَّرْقَدِنَا١ؐٚۘ هٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَ صَدَقَ الْمُرْسَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (nervously) exclaiming. “Alas for us! Who roused us out of our sleeping-place?” “This is what the Merciful One had promised, and what (His) Messengers had said was true.”

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ كَانَتْ اِلَّا صَیْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاِذَا هُمْ جَمِیْعٌ لَّدَیْنَا مُحْضَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then there will simply be one single Blast, and all will have gathered before Us.

ayahs.arabicText: فَالْیَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَیْئًا وَّ لَا تُجْزَوْنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Today no one shall suffer the least injustice, and you shall not be recompensed except according to your deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ اَصْحٰبَ الْجَنَّةِ الْیَوْمَ فِیْ شُغُلٍ فٰكِهُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the people of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves:

ayahs.arabicText: هُمْ وَ اَزْوَاجُهُمْ فِیْ ظِلٰلٍ عَلَى الْاَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِئُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: they and their spouses shall be reclining on their couches in shady groves;

ayahs.arabicText: لَهُمْ فِیْهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَّ لَهُمْ مَّا یَدَّعُوْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: therein there will be all kinds of fruits to eat, and they shall have all that they desire.

ayahs.arabicText: سَلٰمٌ١۫ قَوْلًا مِّنْ رَّبٍّ رَّحِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: “Peace” shall be the word conveyed to them from their Merciful Lord.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ امْتَازُوا الْیَوْمَ اَیُّهَا الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: “Criminals, separate yourselves from others today!

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَمْ اَعْهَدْ اِلَیْكُمْ یٰبَنِیْۤ اٰدَمَ اَنْ لَّا تَعْبُدُوا الشَّیْطٰنَ١ۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِیْنٌۙ
ayahs.translation: Children of Adam, did I not command you not to serve Satan -- he is to you an open enemy

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنِ اعْبُدُوْنِیْ١ؔؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: and serve Me alone: this is the Straight Way?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَضَلَّ مِنْكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِیْرًا١ؕ اَفَلَمْ تَكُوْنُوْا تَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Still, he misguided a whole throng of you. Did you have no sense?

ayahs.arabicText: هٰذِهٖ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِیْ كُنْتُمْ تُوْعَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Now this is the Hell of which you were warned.

ayahs.arabicText: اِصْلَوْهَا الْیَوْمَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Burn in it on account of your disbelieving.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلْیَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلٰۤى اَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَ تُكَلِّمُنَاۤ اَیْدِیْهِمْ وَ تَشْهَدُ اَرْجُلُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْا یَكْسِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Today We shall put a seal on their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us and their feet shall bear witness to what they had been doing.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلٰۤى اَعْیُنِهِمْ فَاسْتَبَقُوا الصِّرَاطَ فَاَنّٰى یُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: If We so willed, We would have put out their eyes, then they would rush to see the Way, but how would they be able to see?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنٰهُمْ عَلٰى مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوْا مُضِیًّا وَّ لَا یَرْجِعُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: If We so willed, We would have transformed them where they were so that they would not go forward or backward.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِی الْخَلْقِ١ؕ اَفَلَا یَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Whomsoever We grant a long life, We reverse him in his constitution. Do they still not understand?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا عَلَّمْنٰهُ الشِّعْرَ وَ مَا یَنْۢبَغِیْ لَهٗ١ؕ اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَّ قُرْاٰنٌ مُّبِیْنٌۙ
ayahs.translation: We did not teach him (to wit, the Messenger) poetry and it does not behove him. This is none but an Admonition, and a Clear Book

ayahs.arabicText: لِّیُنْذِرَ مَنْ كَانَ حَیًّا وَّ یَحِقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَى الْكٰفِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: that he may warn him who is alive and establish an argument against those that deny the Truth.

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَرَوْا اَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُمْ مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ اَیْدِیْنَاۤ اَنْعَامًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مٰلِكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do they not see Our handiwork: We created for them cattle which they own?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ ذَلَّلْنٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوْبُهُمْ وَ مِنْهَا یَاْكُلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We have subjected the cattle to them so that some of them they ride and eat the flesh of others.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَهُمْ فِیْهَا مَنَافِعُ وَ مَشَارِبُ١ؕ اَفَلَا یَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They derive a variety of benefits and drinks from them. Will they, then, not give thanks?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اٰلِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ یُنْصَرُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: They set up deities apart from Allah, hoping that they will receive help from them.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا یَسْتَطِیْعُوْنَ نَصْرَهُمْ١ۙ وَ هُمْ لَهُمْ جُنْدٌ مُّحْضَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Those deities can render them no help. Yet these devotees act as though they were an army in waiting for them.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَا یَحْزُنْكَ قَوْلُهُمْ١ۘ اِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا یُسِرُّوْنَ وَ مَا یُعْلِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Let not their words grieve you. Surely We know all things about them, what they conceal and what they reveal.

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَرَ الْاِنْسَانُ اَنَّا خَلَقْنٰهُ مِنْ نُّطْفَةٍ فَاِذَا هُوَ خَصِیْمٌ مُّبِیْنٌ
ayahs.translation: Does man not see that We created him of a sperm drop, and lo! he is flagrantly contentious?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ ضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَّ نَسِیَ خَلْقَهٗ١ؕ قَالَ مَنْ یُّحْیِ الْعِظَامَ وَ هِیَ رَمِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: He strikes for Us a similitude and forgot his own creation. He says: “Who will quicken the bones when they have decayed?”

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ یُحْیِیْهَا الَّذِیْۤ اَنْشَاَهَاۤ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ١ؕ وَ هُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِیْمُۙ
ayahs.translation: Say: “He Who first brought them into being will quicken them; He knows well about every kind of creation;

ayahs.arabicText: اِ۟لَّذِیْ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الشَّجَرِ الْاَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَاِذَاۤ اَنْتُمْ مِّنْهُ تُوْقِدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He Who created from a green tree a fire for you, a fire to light your stoves with.”

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَیْسَ الَّذِیْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلٰۤى اَنْ یَّخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ١ؐؕ بَلٰى١ۗ وَ هُوَ الْخَلّٰقُ الْعَلِیْمُ
ayahs.translation: Has He Who created the heavens and the earth no power to create the likes of them? Yes, indeed, He is the Superb Creator.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّمَاۤ اَمْرُهٗۤ اِذَاۤ اَرَادَ شَیْئًا اَنْ یَّقُوْلَ لَهٗ كُنْ فَیَكُوْنُ
ayahs.translation: Whenever He wills a thing, He just commands it “Be” and it is.

ayahs.arabicText: فَسُبْحٰنَ الَّذِیْ بِیَدِهٖ مَلَكُوْتُ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ وَّ اِلَیْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Holy is He Who has full control over everything, and to Him you shall all be recalled.
